verdict.rationale: Composed recording with layout options is a fair question for a real-time video SDK, so the axis applies. The evidence pack covers only meetings, video limits, codecs, data messages and PSTN, and says nothing about recording, media capture, compositing or layout options. Absence of evidence for an applicable capability yields none.

support.subject: As a developer, multi-participant recordings can be composed into a single output with documented layout options
